calculation.expression: where(cs_return_5d / volatility_20d is active, -cs_return_5d / volatility_20d, null)
calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark, take the negative five-day cumulative return relative to the daily cross-sectional median, normalize by trailing 20-day daily return volatility, and activate only when cross-sectional daily return dispersion exceeds its trailing 252-day 60th percentile. Values use completed-day data and are lagged for forward-return testing. Higher values indicate stronger short-horizon reversal potential.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC and ICIR in 2020-2022 (0.055496/0.175249), 2023-2025 (0.032793/0.099266), and 2026-2031 (0.030827/0.092228). Small cross-asset universe warrants conservative uncertainty interpretation.
